name: dev.telara/confluence-doc-engagement-pulse
description: Fetch a Confluence page's metadata via the REST API, read its Analytics panel through a bound browser session for view and viewer counts, and classify it as stale_high_traffic, zero_view, or healthy using a fixed threshold rule. Sibling pages from the same space are also fetched via the API for context and reported separately with metadata only -- their Analytics panels are never read in the same run, so they are never assigned a view-based verdict. Read-only; never edits, labels, comments on, or moves any page.

inputs.name: high_traffic_view_threshold
inputs.description: View count at/above which a stale page is stale_high_traffic rather than healthy

inputs.name: page_id
inputs.description: Numeric Confluence page ID to check engagement for this run

inputs.name: space_id
inputs.description: Numeric Confluence space ID that scopes the sibling-page roster fetch

inputs.name: stale_before
inputs.description: ISO date cutoff for the stale bucket
